title: Three-Body Problem as Chinese soft disclosure

tellings.quote: but they've allowed this sci fi series to be published by this Chinese author, that's like pretty trippy.

plain: The idea is that China's government letting The Three-Body Problem, a science fiction series by a Chinese author about contact with aliens, be published may be a form of soft disclosure, a quiet way of getting the public used to the idea of aliens. David Grusch, a former intelligence official who has spoken out about UFOs, tells Michels "that's like pretty trippy." If he is right, China would be preparing its people for something it knows.
